title: CaptionFool: Universal Image Captioning Model Attacks

bias_targets.methodology: Applying universal adversarial perturbations (CaptionFool) to image patches to measure the vision-language model's vulnerability to being forced to generate targeted racial slurs and racist slang from the Racial Slur Database.

Measuring the attack success rate of adversarial image perturbations in tricking the captioning model into outputting arbitrary profanities and offensive words from the Surge.AI Obscenity List to evaluate evasion of content moderation filters.
